content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6 to 2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. That range is well supported for muscle growth. Spread it over 3 to 5 meals, with roughly 20 to 40 g each. 💪

Eating more than that isn't harmful for most healthy people, but it usually doesn't add extra muscle. Pair the protein with a slight calorie surplus and consistent progressive overload on your bench work. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🥜
